decisive_items: Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos were identified
immunocompromised status due to kidney transplant
Extensive dermal collection of lymphocytes, histiocytes, and macrophages
response.rationale: Histopathology shows intracellular yeasts with halos in an immunocompromised transplant patient, classic for cryptococcosis. R2 shares dermal histiocytic infiltrate but lacks yeast-specific finding; neoplastic and other infectious candidates do not match the yeast morphology.

rejected.why: Painless nodules with crusting are nonspecific; no yeast or histiocytic infiltrate support.
Histiocytic infiltrate present but no mention of intracellular yeasts with halos; less specific than R3.
Arborizing telangiectasias and ulceration suggest BCC, but histopathology contradicts epithelial tumor.
Ulcerated nodules can occur, but no organism or histiocytic pattern supporting leishmaniasis.
Ulceration and telangiectasias are nonspecific; no histopathologic evidence of squamous carcinoma.
